expected_spec.target_system: red flag mounted on yellow base
expected_spec.intervention: Continue the calibrated fan airflow at 5.0 m/s.
expected_spec.expected_response: The red flag will maintain a consistent, steady deformation pattern, fluttering or waving in a regular manner due to the constant 5.0 m/s wind.
causal_checks: Flag fabric moves due to air pressure differential from airflow.
Flag orientation changes as airflow direction changes.
Flag deformation amplitude correlates with airflow velocity.
protected_anchors: Flag does not tear or detach
failure_modes: Flag becomes limp or collapses if airflow is insufficient
Flag flutters erratically if airflow is unstable
Flag detaches from pole if mounting is compromised
